company_name: NISSIN ALLIS ION EQUIPMENT (SHANGHAI) CO., LTD
semiconductor_relevance: High — Nissin Allis Ion Equipment specializes in ion implantation equipment and services for semiconductor manufacturing, particularly for high-definition flat panel displays and power devices.
summary: Nissin Allis Ion Equipment (Shanghai) Co., Ltd is a leading provider of high-temperature medium-current ion implantation equipment, holding the No. 1 worldwide market share in this segment. The company offers tailored solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, leveraging advanced sheet beam technology and extensive field experience.
capabilities: High-temperature medium-current ion implantation equipment for SiC

regional_presence.China: The company operates in Shanghai, focusing on the semiconductor equipment market.
